title: GET /management/v1/health — success response
$comment: RC3 §10. Status is defined over two sets: E, the advertised capabilities with state=enabled, and I, the contents of degraded_capabilities. Most of the E/I relationship needs /capabilities and lives in invariants I-04, I-06 and I-07; the conditionals below encode every part that a single health response determines on its own. additionalProperties is false for PROVIDER conformance only; see README. Array sortedness (§8) is invariant I-01.

management_provider_release_id.$comment: RC3 §10.2: current opaque MANAGEMENT-PROVIDER release ID (not the managed synth's). Must equal /version management_provider.release_id — cross-endpoint invariant I-03.

degraded_capabilities.$comment: RC3 §10.2: the impaired set I. A SORTED SET of unique advertised, ENABLED capability IDs authoritatively known to be impaired. Disabled and deprecated capabilities are not impaired and must not appear — enforced by invariant I-06.

reason_codes.$comment: RC3 §10.2: a sorted set of unique safe codes. Non-empty when status=unknown; see the conditionals below.

retry_after_seconds.$comment: RC3 §10.2: 1-3600; absent when no estimate is available. Absent, never null (§8).

allOf.$comment: RC3 §10: 'healthy' requires I to be empty.
RC3 §10: 'degraded' requires I to be a NON-EMPTY proper subset of E. Only the non-empty half is decidable from one response; the proper-subset half is invariant I-04.
RC3 §10: when status=unknown, reason_codes MUST be non-empty. Unknown is an observability state, and Control is entitled to be told why serviceability could not be established.

RC3 §10: 'unspecified' MUST NOT appear alongside any other reason code AT ANY STATUS. Once a specific reason is known, the fallback adds nothing. Whether a more specific code would have been truthful is evidentiary and cannot be checked here.

RC3 §10: 'unavailable' with a non-empty E requires I = E, so an empty I under 'unavailable' can only be the zero-enabled branch — which requires no_enabled_capabilities. This conditional is what makes the RC2-era defect (unavailable with an empty impaired set and no explanation) catchable from a single response.
RC3 §10: no_enabled_capabilities means E is empty. An empty E excludes healthy, degraded and unknown, all of which require a non-empty E, so the status must be unavailable.
RC3 §10: no_enabled_capabilities means E is empty, and I is a subset of E, so I must also be empty.
